full_page.content:
RETREAT 2nd Day
1945, August
III Conference
"Obedience in Spirit not according to the letter."
..... Humility is Patience if an "inferior" and a subject; Greater humility and greater patience and prudence too if a Superior
Tuesday - III Day
I Conference
"Suffering" - three fold-view - Natural, philosophic, ascetic. Resisted, accepted, embraced with appreciation. Suffering the lot - earthly destiny of every mortal from cradel to grave - Nolen - Volense Deo Gratias
II Converence
"HUMILITY and SIMPLICITY"
(Of myself) I am nothing. Only inasmuch as I shall succeed in humbling myself can I expect to anything in God's eye - anything therefore in reality worth seeing. Humility and Simplicity belong together and to one another more than do twin sister.
III Confer .- "HOLY POVERTY"
Out-standing characterick of Orders of St. St. Francis. Blessed are to poor in spirit - for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
IV Confer. - "Blessed are the Clean of heart for they shall see God"
First law of nature, Self-preservation. Next to this law - nay essentially belonging to it is Self-propagation ..... Whence then the law of Chastity? In general there is no law beinding to perfect Chas- tity. In general it is only a counsel. Chastity becomes a law for the privileged few - for priests and religious who by the grace of vo- cation take it as a holy vow .... all the more effectually to propigate Jesus Christ and themselves spiritually.
Wednesday
I Conference - "Means of preserving Chastity"
Devotion to Jesus in the Blessed Sacram't and to Mary His - our Bl. Mother. Foster confidence in Jesus by appealing to Mary our Bl. Mother to help us and be our teacher in learning to know Jesus, so that we may love Him and serve Him.
